hook.text: Five AI projects, ten days old, thousands of GitHub stars. Here's what they actually do.

item0.text: Number five: Vibe Wise. A Claude Code plugin that makes you plan first, so you learn while AI codes.

item1.text: Number four: Remove Mac A I. The twist: it turns Apple Intelligence off and deletes its models.

item2.text: Number three: Coo coo. A tiny notch buddy that watches your coding agents and lets you approve them.

item3.text: Number two: Open Dots. An open-source template for AI coworkers that each get their own computer.

item4.text: And number one: Universal Modder. Point your AI coding agent at a game you own, and it builds the mod.

cta.text: Which one should I test on camera? Comment the number, and follow for next week's list.
